description: One grouped PR for all minor/patch/digest updates; automerged when every check passes
0.x minors can break: never automerge them
Python minor/major: the Docker python base image and actions/setup-python's python-version move together in ONE PR, and only after a human approves it on the Dependency Dashboard.
A new Python minor ships months before its ecosystem wheels (pydantic-core etc.), and hash-locked requirements compiled for the old minor fail to install on it.

Not minimumReleaseAge: Docker Hub's release timestamp is the tag's tag_last_pushed, so the floating python:3.N-alpine tag re-ages on every rebuild and would be held forever while the setup-python side cleared, splitting the pair again.
Patch and digest bumps of the pinned base stay in the non-major group.
vite, its plugins and vitest have to move together
openai pins its zod peer range, so bump them together
